title: B-tree free-page has-content query and clear

scope.rationale: btreeGetHasContent decides whether a reused freelist page must be read with content by treating out-of-range pages as content-bearing and testing tracked pages; btreeClearHasContent destroys the write-transaction bit vector at transaction conclusion.

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete query and clear bodies are assigned; freelist caller integration remains open.

inputs: Shared B-tree state and one-based page number for query; mutable Shared for clear
outputs: False with no vector, true for out-of-range page, tracked bit otherwise; clear releases vector and sets null
contracts.ownership: Query borrows vector; clear consumes its allocation.
contracts.state_and_results: Out-of-range is conservatively true. In-range uses exact tracked bit. Clear is idempotent.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns shared B-tree mutex; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: No allocation or error path. Clear leaves future queries false until tracking is recreated.

representation_differences: A nullable bool slice replaces source Bitvec; its length includes the unused zero index and represents sqlite3BitvecSize+1.

oracle.protocol: Track page 2, then observe tracked true, out-of-range true, untracked in-range false, clear ownership, and null vector.

assurance.oom: Query/clear allocate nothing; set owner handles OOM.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller shared mutex external.
assurance.malformed_input: Page zero is outside intended one-based caller contract but safely reads index zero when in range.
assurance.continuation: Clear permits lazy recreation in a later write transaction.

integration.native_call_path: Typed query/clear and all source-significant branches are unit-traced; freelist reuse caller remains pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires freelist/transaction integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Call clear at exact write-transaction conclusion.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:645-686 was reviewed completely for set/query/clear context
src/core/internal/btree_core.zig setHasContent, Shared lifetime, freelist, and tests were reviewed
assertions_branches_cleanup: The sole query control-flow block is assigned; clear is straight-line
upstream_tests: Upstream freelist reuse, no-content pager, rollback, and transaction tests cover these owners
Project unit trace covers every query branch and clear
